claim: A sample chapter reaches a clear end summary.
sandbox: fresh /demo; play the valid tend token; assert the garden-restored summary and score

claim: A finished chapter can restart from turn one.
sandbox: finish the sample; replay the seed; assert turn one and zero points

claim: Any present player can place a sleeping player's queued token.
sandbox: sample room; mark the current player sleeping; place the queued token; assert the group action log

claim: Two remote browsers can join one room, alternate turns, and reach the same end screen.
sandbox: two fresh contexts; create and join by code and name; alternate 12 actions; assert both show the same end summary

claim: A player reconnects to the synchronized room after a refresh.
sandbox: two fresh contexts in one room; play two turns; reload the second browser; assert its private token restores turn three

claim: The sound setting persists.
sandbox: sample room; switch sound off; reload; assert it remains off

claim: The visited demo reloads offline.
sandbox: own fresh context; visit /demo; await service worker; set offline; reload; assert game and offline state

claim: Demo play sends no player data away from the site.
sandbox: fresh demo; record every request through completion; assert every request is same-origin

claim: The game supports keyboard and touch play.
sandbox: one fresh keyboard context and one 390 px touch context; complete the sample with each input method

claim: An online room supports two to four players and lasts 12 turns.
sandbox: fresh setup; add two players; create the room; assert four player rows and 12-turn status

claim: Each chapter is designed for a 15-minute session.
sandbox: fresh landing page; assert the 12-turn, 15-minute chapter description

claim: The same seed creates the same beds and weather.
sandbox: construct two games with the same seed and compare their beds and first weather

claim: Weather changes after each action.
sandbox: play three valid actions in a deterministic game and compare the weather for all four turns

claim: The scene animation has median frame pacing of at least 55 frames per second in the test browser.
sandbox: fresh desktop Chromium demo; sample 90 animation intervals; discard warmup frames; require median pacing of at least 55 fps

claim: A visitor can create one free online chapter without an account.
sandbox: fresh context; create an online room without a license or account; assert turn one and the board

claim: The game has no timer, account, chat, or public player list.
sandbox: fresh demo; assert a turn count and no email, password, or chat controls

claim: The demo uses separate session storage and discards its state when starting for real.
where: demo banner, demo guide, privacy, and README
sandbox: seed a real-data sentinel; enter through /?demo=1; assert demo storage; leave and assert demo state is removed while the sentinel remains

claim: Online rooms connect only to Pause Garden's configured room server.
sandbox: record page and WebSocket destinations while creating a room; assert only the static origin and configured room origin occur

claim: The room server synchronizes turns and keeps room state in SQLite.
sandbox: two clients share a turn; restart over the same temporary SQLite file; assert the turn remains

claim: The room server removes rooms after 30 inactive days.
sandbox: create a room at a fixed time; advance 30 days and one second; run cleanup; assert the room is gone

claim: Host Edition is not for sale while checkout is unavailable.
sandbox: open landing and completed-free-chapter setup; assert the unavailable control is disabled and no checkout link exists

claim: The footer build identifier matches the static artifact's source commit.
sandbox: fresh landing page from the built artifact; assert the full source commit metadata and matching short footer identifier
